title: Stone Points From Arabia May Have Carried Poison
paragraphs: Long ago, people lived near a lake in Saudi Arabia. Today it is a desert. This was about 125,000 years ago.
Scientists found more than 5,000 stone tools there. Some stone points had glue and plant fibres on them. People put them on wooden sticks to hunt.
Some points also had traces of a poison plant. But the scientists are not sure. They say it may be poison.

questions.q: How many stone tools did scientists find?
Are the scientists sure about the poison?
questions.a: No, they say it may be poison.
